system.boundary: Build a complete complex-baseband SISO VHT WLAN link in Simulink for a fixed 20 MHz channel and one packet per run.
engineering_objects: F90-XCOMM-07 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: channel_waveform, bit_recovery, header_constellation, data_constellation, packet_detection, cfo_estimation
physical_paths: wlan_link_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: mcs is an integer from 0 through 7; channel_coding is a character vector or string equal to BCC or LDPC; snr_dB is a real scalar in 18--35 dB; and carrier_frequency_offset_Hz is a real scalar in -100000--100000 Hz.

Generate a reproducible nontrivial payload, construct the VHT packet through the actual scrambling, channel coding, interleaving, QAM mapping, pilot/training-field insertion, and OFDM modulation path, and pass the waveform through a multipath channel with the requested AWGN and carrier-frequency offset.

The connected receiver must perform packet detection, coarse and fine time/frequency synchronization, OFDM demodulation, training-field channel estimation, equalization, common-phase correction, header recovery, and BCC or LDPC payload decoding.
functional_paths: Packet detection and CFO estimates must come from the synchronization path.
information_paths: wlan_link_input -> F90-XCOMM-07 plant/control path -> channel_waveform, bit_recovery, header_constellation, data_constellation, packet_detection, cfo_estimation
modes_and_events: F90-XCOMM-07 startup and continuous operation follow the current public task contract.

interfaces.name: channel_waveform
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: channel_waveform has width 2 in this order: real, imag; both are in normalized amplitude, with receiver input sample index as time. channel_waveform must be the impaired waveform that actually drives the receiver.

interfaces.name: bit_recovery
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: bit_recovery has width 3 in this order: tx_bit, decoded_bit, bit_error; all have unit 1, with valid decoded-bit index as time. bit_recovery must pair the actual transmitted and valid decoded payload bits and include their XOR error indicator.

interfaces.name: header_constellation
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: header_constellation has width 2 in this order: in_phase, quadrature; both are in normalized amplitude, with valid header-symbol index as time.

interfaces.name: data_constellation
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: data_constellation has width 2 in this order: in_phase, quadrature; both are in normalized amplitude, with valid data-symbol index as time.

interfaces.name: packet_detection
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: packet_detection has width 1: detected, unit 1, with receiver processing sample index as time.

interfaces.name: cfo_estimation
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: cfo_estimation has width 2 in this order: normalized_frequency in cycles/sample, estimated_frequency_Hz in Hz, with valid CFO-estimate index as time.
